verdict.rationale: Daytona documents Network Limits: each sandbox sits behind a firewall that controls which external IPs and domains it can reach. Firewall parameters can be set when the sandbox is created or updated while it runs, which gives a platform engineer explicit control over egress policy. Missing for 10: detailed policy syntax and semantics (e.g., allowlist vs. block-all modes, CIDR/wildcard support) in the excerpts, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the firewall enforces as documented.
